
{{alias}}( N, workspace, strideW, offsetW )
    Initializes a workspace array for performing a complex-valued Fourier
    transform.

    The workspace array is divided into three sections:

    1. scratch/workspace: the section ranges from indices 0 to 2N-1 and is used
    while performing transforms. This section is not updated during
    initialization.

    2. twiddle factors: the section ranges from indices 2N to 4N-1 and stores a
    table of reusable complex exponential constants as cosine/sine pairs.

    3. radix factor table: the section starts at index 4N and stores the
    sequence length N, the number of factors into which N was decomposed, and
    the individual integer radix factors.

    Any remaining array space remains as unused storage.

    Parameters
    ----------
    N: integer
        Length of the sequence.

    workspace: Complex128Array
        Workspace array.

    strideW: integer
        Stride length for `workspace`.

    offsetW: integer
        Starting index for `workspace`.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Complex128Array
        Workspace array.

    Examples
    --------
    > var N = 8;
    > var wbuf = {{alias:@stdlib/random/array/uniform}}( ( 4*N ) + 34, -100.0, 100.0 );
    > var workspace = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/complex128}}( wbuf.buffer );
    > var out = {{alias}}( N, workspace, 1, 0 )
    <Complex128Array>
    > var bool = ( out === workspace )
    true
    > var twiddleFactors = wbuf.slice( 2*N, 3*N )
    <Float64Array>[ 1, 0, ~0.707, ~0.707, ~0, 1, ~-0.707, ~0.707 ]
    > var factors = wbuf.slice( 4*N, ( 4*N ) + 4 )
    <Float64Array>[ 8, 2, 2, 4 ]

    See Also
    --------
